description: Script for automating the process of updating and integrating the Abseil C++ library into Chromium, including cloning, syncing, patching, and committing changes.

methods.name: _PullAbseil
methods.description: Clones the Abseil repository into the specified directory.

methods.name: _SyncChromium
methods.description: Checks out the main branch and pulls latest changes in the Chromium repository.

methods.name: _UpdateChromiumReadme
methods.description: Updates the README with the latest Abseil revision hash.

methods.name: _UpdateAbseilInChromium
methods.description: Syncs Abseil source into Chromium's third_party directory, excluding certain files.

methods.name: _PatchAbseil
methods.description: Applies patches to the Abseil source and removes specific header files.

methods.name: _Commit
methods.description: Commits the updated Abseil source in Chromium and uploads the change.

methods.name: _Roll
methods.description: Coordinates the entire process of updating and integrating Abseil into Chromium.
